_law: THIS LIST ONLY SHRINKS. A feature here may stay unfiled (taxonomy_node_id null) for the stated reason; a NEW unfiled feature fails check:settings-ladder-ui and must never be added here.
_why: Migration 0631 (aidream/db/migrations/0631_feature_knob_taxonomy_mapping.sql) deliberately left the commerce.* namespaces unmapped: there is no commerce domain in platform.taxonomy_node and the vocabulary law forbids an agent coining one. Naming that domain is Arman's call; the settings UI shows these under 'Not filed under a domain yet' until then.
_shrunk: 2026-09-12 — commerce.market, commerce.quota and commerce.research removed: their rows are platform-engineering-only (overridable_by empty), so the guard never grades them and the entry was dead weight. Opening one to an organization now fails the guard until it is filed under a domain, which is the point.
